**After this chapter you should be able to** produce a search record that another librarian can rerun, audit and update.

## Planned contents

- A completed reporting package: PRISMA-S [@rethlefsen2021] plus AI use reported under the joint position statement [@flemyng2025].
- A deduplication record [@mckeown2021], using the Moran case's spread of 5,390 to 5,552 records after duplicates removed.
- Updating: the entry-date limits in CD010558 and CD011787, and why rerunning a saved query does not establish stable coverage.
- An update case in which subject indexing, ranking and an AI tool have all changed.
